integrity: The displayed original closed form follows from stationary second moments and a Poisson coboundary; numerical finite-time moment integration independently corroborates but does not replace proof. Scientific publication priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact proof is for joint-stationary one-dimensional overdamped diffusion and independent two-state exponentially switched off/on harmonic stiffness with positive parameters. No general partial-stiffness, heat-work, or inertial claim. Related broad additive-functional publications may imply some specialization.
title: Exact switching-work fluctuations in an intermittently harmonic Brownian trap
